name: claim without a currency, receipt in CAD, earlier spend over the USD ceiling: OVER_SCOPE final at once (v1.6)
notes: Same input as scenario 69 before contract v1.6: grant ceiling 5000 USD; c1 and c2 both say 'bought it at Acme for 30' with no currency; both receipts say 3000 CAD; receiptMerchants is patched to ['acme'] (§6.1).
Scores as in 69: Σw = 7000 (timeProximity 2500, amountExact 2500, merchantMatch 2000); c1 × o1 and c2 × o2 each S = 4500/7000 = 9/14 ≥ 1/2 → assigned (amountExact 0: the claim has no currency).

amountAboveCeiling: Amount = the claim's 3000 (currency absent, so it counts) ≤ 5000; the assigned candidate's currency CAD ≠ USD → true, reason ceiling.currency_mismatch {currency: CAD, spendCurrency: USD} → rule over_ceiling for both claims (it comes before over_ceiling_cumulative, and a rule names only its own conditions' codes, §15).

cumulativeAboveCeiling (§6.1, §6.3 v1.6): a claim with no currency is counted in spendCurrency, by its own guard and by priorSpendCents. c1 has no earlier spend. For c2, priorSpendCents = c1's 3000, and 3000 + 3000 = 6000 > 5000 → true.

Finality (§8): c1 (end 10:03) has a receipt sync at 14:30 ≥ 10:48 → FINAL either way. c2 (end 14:03): 14:30 < 14:48, so a candidate-dependent OVER_SCOPE would wait. But without o2 the rule over_ceiling_cumulative still concludes OVER_SCOPE from claim-only facts, so c2 is FINAL at once (Hard Rule 5: leaving the currency out never lets spend escape the cumulative ceiling).
o1 is outside c2's window [14:00, 14:48] and o2 outside c1's [10:00, 10:48].
